scope: Fourteen native queries in one occupation list, actual owned-window WM_CHAR input and WM_KEYDOWN/UP backspace clearing between queries. Captured ordered results agree with contiguous substring matching against existing native name_sort_key bytes.
exclusions: No non-ASCII query-entry or full normalization-table acceptance
No Escape, focus-loss, actual DF3D editing-input or held-input acceptance; editing captures cover discrete append/backspace and a right-icon click only
No cross-header/role or refreshed-list filtering acceptance
focus_exclusion: Immediate Escape down/up pair had no effect and is excluded; earlier held Escape closed multiple screens. No Escape acceptance.
